claim: Tree-based multi-label conformal prediction casts multi-label classification as a hierarchical multiple-hypothesis-testing problem, deriving per-label conformal p-values and proving family-wise-error-rate control -- the closest generic template for per-requirement risk control, but never applied to code or execution oracles.
stance_target: existence of generic multi-label conformal machinery adaptable to per-requirement code risk control
scope_conditions: general multi-label classification, independent feature vectors, COPA 2023
quoted_support: We establish a theoretical guarantee of valid coverage for the prediction sets through proven family-wise error rate control of those two procedures.
